description: National Medicine Regulatory Authority - Amendment to Medicines (Ceiling on Prices) Regulation - 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No. 5 of 2015, specifically amending price control regulations for medicines. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for medicine pricing, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
